mapper.sql: SELECT p.book_id, b.title AS book_title, b.chapter_count, p.chapter_index, p.paragraph_index, c.title AS chapter_title, p.updated_at FROM reading_progress p JOIN books b ON p.book_id = b.id JOIN chapters c ON c.book_id = p.book_id AND c.chapter_index = p.chapter_index
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_progress (book_id, chapter_index, paragraph_index, updated_at) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{chapterIndex}, #{paragraphIndex}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_progress SET chapter_index = #{chapterIndex}, paragraph_index = #{paragraphIndex}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, chapter_index, paragraph_index, started_at, elapsed_seconds, reading_day, updated_at FROM reading_sessions WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.book_id, b.title AS book_title, s.chapter_index, s.paragraph_index, c.title AS chapter_title, s.started_at, s.elapsed_seconds, s.updated_at FROM reading_sessions s JOIN books b ON s.book_id = b.id JOIN chapters c ON c.book_id = s.book_id AND c.chapter_index = s.chapter_index
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_sessions (id, book_id, chapter_index, paragraph_index, started_at, elapsed_seconds, reading_day, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{bookId}, #{chapterIndex}, #{paragraphIndex}, #{startedAt}, #{elapsedSeconds}, #{readingDay}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(elapsed_seconds), 0) FROM reading_sessions WHERE reading_day = #{date}
SELECT reading_day AS "date", SUM(elapsed_seconds) AS seconds FROM reading_sessions WHERE reading_day >= #{date} GROUP BY reading_day ORDER BY reading_day
SELECT b.id AS book_id, b.title, SUM(s.elapsed_seconds) AS seconds FROM reading_sessions s JOIN books b ON b.id = s.book_id GROUP BY b.id, b.title ORDER BY seconds DESC, b.id
